items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: he hired me to come into the band and we went down to Hellener, Arkansas.

ctx.x: With him. Cook heard me play. We did a parade out at sweet home and somebody pointed this guy out to me. This guy had a band and I decided that my life wasn't going to be made with this band; so I put my X-notes in there. I played, I played, I played. I put my things in there. When it got down to solo, I played me a swing solo. Which Mr.
Cook didn't like it all. But I didn't care because I wanted to impress Cook, and obviously I did because he hired me to come into the band and we went down to Hellener, Arkansas.
We were playing at a drug store.
